title: What mass spectrometry measures
summary: From molecules to ions to evidence: understand what a mass spectrum can—and cannot—tell you.
zh_summary: 从分子到离子，再到证据：理解质谱能够回答和无法单独回答的问题。

title: m/z, charge & isotopes
summary: Calculate ion masses, recognize charge states, and separate accuracy from resolving power.
zh_summary: 计算离子质量、识别电荷态，并区分质量准确度与分辨本领。

title: How molecules become ions
summary: Compare ESI, MALDI, EI, and APCI by the chemistry they enable—not by a universal ranking.
zh_summary: 根据电离过程与适用化学性质比较 ESI、MALDI、EI 和 APCI。

title: Mass analyzers & resolution
summary: Understand quadrupoles, time of flight, ion traps, and frequency-based measurements.
zh_summary: 理解四极杆、飞行时间、离子阱以及基于频率的测量。

title: Fragmentation & tandem MS
summary: Follow precursor selection, activation, and product-ion evidence without overcalling a structure.
zh_summary: 理解前体选择、活化及产物离子证据，避免过度推断结构。

title: Read a spectrum step by step
summary: Turn a peak list into testable hypotheses using metadata, isotope patterns, and fragment evidence.
zh_summary: 结合元数据、同位素模式和碎片证据，把峰列表转变为可检验的假设。

title: Acquisition: full scan, DDA, DIA & targeted
zh_title: 采集：全扫描、DDA、DIA 与靶向
summary: Choose which evidence to record and understand the consequences for coverage and quantification.
zh_summary: 理解不同采集方式保留的证据，以及对覆盖度和定量的影响。

title: From raw data to reliable results
zh_title: 从原始数据到可靠结果
summary: Build a reproducible analysis: features, identification, quantification, quality control, and confidence.
zh_summary: 构建可复现的分析：特征、鉴定、定量、质量控制和置信度。
